basic_details.job_title: OSSC CHSL Specialist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 132 Technical Assistant, Weaving Supervisor and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Caretaker (State Cadre), Weaving Supervisor (State Cadre), Primary Investigator (State Cadre) and 2 more
basic_details.short_information: Odisha Staff Selection Commission (OSSC), Bhubaneswar, has invited applications for 132 posts in 5 roles under Advt No. ILE-21/2026-4273/OSSC. The posts include Caretaker (State Cadre), Weaving Supervisor (State Cadre), Primary Investigator (State Cadre), Technical Assistant (State Cadre) and 1 more. The online application is open from 25 November 2026 to 28 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online through Odisha Treasury portal linked with the online application form. Last date to pay the fee: 24 December 2026.

exam_pattern.details: Negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in the Preliminary MCQ paper Commission may fix minimum qualifying marks by category and post Preliminary and Main examinations conducted in both Odia and English; medium option once given cannot be changed No re-evaluation or re-checking of scores Normalisation formula (Notice No.2444/OSSC dated 02.09.2021) applies if exam is held in multiple batches

how_to_apply: Apply online only through the OSSC website www.ossc.gov.in.
Register online and pay the Rs. 500 examination fee through the Odisha Treasury portal linked with the form by 24-12-2026.
Give options for the posts/services and the medium of examination (Odia or English) in the form.
Enter bank account details (Account Number, IFSC, account holder name, bank branch) for the fee refund.
Submit the online application form by 28-12-2026; no hard copy is to be sent.
important_instructions: Admission Letters will not be sent by post; download from www.ossc.gov.in Fee refunded to candidates who actually appear in the first stage of the examination Candidates applying for more than one post are allotted posts on merit-cum-preference; no later change of post Unfilled women vacancies go to eligible male candidates of the same category Complaints on exam conduct to [email protected] within 05 days of the exam Transgender candidates are also eligible to apply

content_sections.heading: How Will OSSC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Stage-I: Preliminary Examination (OMR/CBRE), 150 marks, MCQ Stage-II: Main Written Examination (OMR/CBRE), Technical Paper, 200 marks Stage-III: Certificate Verification Preliminary: one 150-mark MCQ paper; minimum 5 times the vacancies category-wise shortlisted for the Main Main Written: Technical Paper of 200 marks as per the post's qualification 2 times the vacancies (post-wise and category-wise) shortlisted for Certificate Verification Merit list prepared category-wise on Main Written marks and post options Ties resolved by Preliminary marks, then older age, then alphabetical order

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for OSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 28 December 2026. Applications opened on 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in OSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 132 vacancies: 2 Caretaker (State Cadre), 15 Weaving Supervisor (State Cadre), 3 Primary Investigator (State Cadre), 32 Technical Assistant (State Cadre), 80 Tax and Fees Collector (Special drive for ST & SC Category).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for OSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 28 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates other than SC, ST and PwD: Rs. 500. SC, ST and PwD: No fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Caretaker (State Cadre): 21 to 42 years; Weaving Supervisor (State Cadre): 21 to 42 years; Primary Investigator (State Cadre): 18 to 42 years; Technical Assistant (State Cadre): 20 to 42 years; Tax and Fees Collector (Special drive for ST & SC Category): 21 to 42 years. Relaxation: SEBC/SC/ST/All Women 5 years, PwD 10 years, Ex-Servicemen Total period of service rendered in defence service, PwD of ST & SC Cumulative 10 years over and above the category relaxation.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level-9 (Cell-1) of ORSP, 2017 for Caretaker (State Cadre), Level-9 (Cell-1) of ORSP, 2017 for Weaving Supervisor (State Cadre), Level-5 (Cell-1) of ORSP, 2017 for Primary Investigator (State Cadre), Level-4 (Cell-1) of ORSP, 2017 for Technical Assistant (State Cadre), Level-4 (Cell-1) of ORSP, 2017 for Tax and Fees Collector (Special drive for ST & SC Category).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Caretaker: 10+2 with Diploma in Hospitality/Hotel Management; Weaving Supervisor: Diploma in Handloom/Textile Technology; Primary Investigator: +2 with Economics or Statistics; Technical Assistant: HSC or Matriculation with PMF/Handloom Weaving & Design Training; Tax and Fees Collector: Higher Secondary/+2 with Basic Computer Knowledge. Odia proficiency required for all posts. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a citizen of India, of good character and of sound health. If married, must not have more than one spouse living. Must be able to read, write and speak Odia fluently and meet one of the four Odia examination conditions. Valid e-mail ID and mobile number to be kept active till the end of recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: PwD certificates marked 'likely to improve' (temporary disability) are not eligible for PwD reservation. BSF, Indian Coast Guard, CRPF and other Para Military Forces are not within the definition of Ex-Servicemen. PwD candidates not availing scribe in the Preliminary Examination will not be allowed a scribe in the Main Written Examination.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Stage-I: Preliminary Examination (OMR/CBRE), 150 marks, MCQ. Stage-II: Main Written Examination (OMR/CBRE), Technical Paper, 200 marks. Stage-III: Certificate Verification. Preliminary: one 150-mark MCQ paper; minimum 5 times the vacancies category-wise shortlisted for the Main.
